topography.project_purpose: CDP. Structurally: 101 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 5 ERC4626 vaults, 12 ERC20 tokens, 2 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 22 common project-authored base contract(s) (managedleveragedvaultgettersv1, basemanagedleveragedvaultgetters, erc4626upgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
